user_input: A customer says their phone was just stolen. What must the agent do first, and how is the caller verified before the line is fully suspended?
response:
I am very sorry to hear your phone was stolen. I have initiated the emergency suspension of outgoing calls and data to prevent any unauthorized activity. For your security, could you please provide three pieces of verification information so I can fully secure the account for you?

Agent steps:
- Navigate to CRM BSS -> Subscriber Services -> Emergency Actions and select 'Suspend Outgoing (OG) Calls & Data' immediately.
- Verify the caller's identity by requesting at least 3 mandatory security checkpoints as per security protocols.
reference: The agent must immediately suspend outgoing calls and data in CRM BSS (Subscriber Services -> Emergency Actions -> Suspend Outgoing (OG) Calls & Data) to prevent fraud and OTP interception. The caller is then authenticated with the full 14-digit Egyptian National ID or passport number registered on the account, the last top-up or bill payment amount and channel (Fawry, WE Pay, credit card), and three frequently dialed numbers or the primary package name. After verification, the line is upgraded to Two-Way Full Barring, and line validity is preserved for 90 days with no recurring package fees.

- Confirm the customer's subscription tier (e.g., Indigo Gold or Platinum) to check for waiver eligibility.
- Perform the line suspension protocol if not already completed.
- Collect the required account details (last payment amount, channel, or frequent contacts) for security validation.
reference: A lost or stolen SIM replacement costs 50 EGP. The fee can be waived for VIP Indigo Gold and Platinum customers. The customer needs the original National ID of the line owner, and the SIM is activated within 30 minutes.

- Inform the customer of the 100 EGP issuance fee.
- Perform SMS 2FA verification before sending the QR code via encrypted PDF or providing a printed voucher.
reference: The agent must confirm that the device EID (the 32-digit Embedded Identity Document) is whitelisted in WE BSS. Supported models include iPhone XS and later, Samsung Galaxy S20 and later, and Google Pixel 4 and later.

user_input: Can I waive a customer's late payment fee, and what are the conditions?
response:
I understand that unexpected fees can be frustrating, and I would be happy to help you with that. We offer a one-time annual courtesy waiver for late fees for our loyal customers. To process this, we just need to ensure your account has been active for at least six months, no similar waiver has been applied in the last year, and your past-due balance is currently paid in full. If you meet these criteria, I can apply that waiver for you right now.

Agent steps:
- Verify that the customer account has been active for at least 6 consecutive months.
- Confirm that no other late fee waiver has been applied in the last 365 calendar days.
- Ensure the customer's past-due balance is paid in full before applying the waiver.
- Apply the credit in the CRM using the reason code 'COURTESY_ANNUAL_WAIVER_LATE_FEE'.
reference: Yes. Customers get a one-time courtesy waiver of the late payment fee (15 EGP for home internet or 25 EGP for postpaid mobile) once every 12 rolling months, if the account has been active for at least 6 consecutive months, no more than 1 late fee waiver was applied in the prior 365 days, and the past-due balance is paid in full at the time of the waiver. The CSR applies it directly in CRM with reason code COURTESY_ANNUAL_WAIVER_LATE_FEE, without escalation.

user_input: During a fiber installation the technician measured -26 dBm. Is that acceptable, and what are the optical power thresholds?
response:
Thank you for reaching out. Regarding your fiber installation, a measurement of -26 dBm is classified as an 'Acceptable' signal, though it is considered marginal. Our guidelines recommend that technicians perform a thorough cable inspection when readings fall in this range to ensure your connection remains stable and avoid potential dropouts. Please confirm if your technician has completed a physical inspection of the fiber line or if you are experiencing any service interruptions.

Agent steps:
- Inform the customer that -26 dBm falls within the 'Acceptable' (Yellow Status) range.
- Advise the customer that while this range works, it is considered marginal and requires a physical cable inspection to ensure there are no sharp bends or damage to the fiber line.
- Verify if the technician has performed the necessary cable inspection to optimize the signal.
reference: -26 dBm is in the acceptable but marginal range (-24.1 to -27.0 dBm, yellow status), which requires cable inspection. The optimal range is -15.0 to -24.0 dBm (green). Worse than -27.1 dBm is defective (red) and needs immediate FAT box re-splicing. Signal stronger than -8.0 dBm risks damaging the ONT receiver. Power is measured with an optical power meter at 1490 nm downstream and 1310 nm upstream.

user_input: العميل فعّل الخط لكن الإنترنت لا يعمل على الموبايل. ما هي إعدادات نقطة الوصول APN الصحيحة؟

أهلاً بك، يسعدني مساعدتك في ضبط إعدادات الإنترنت. يرجى الدخول إلى إعدادات شبكة الهاتف وإضافة نقطة وصول (APN) جديدة بالبيانات التالية: الاسم (WE Internet)، ونقطة الوصول (we.internet)، مع ضبط MCC على 602 و MNC على 04، ونوع الـ APN على (default,supl). بعد حفظ الإعدادات، يرجى إعادة تشغيل هاتفك وستعمل الخدمة معك فوراً.

- التأكد من ضبط الحقول الإضافية (MCC: 602, MNC: 04, APN Type: default,supl).
- الطلب من العميل حفظ الإعدادات وإعادة تشغيل الهاتف.
reference: يجب إدخال إعدادات APN يدوياً: الاسم WE Internet، و APN هو we.internet، و Proxy و Port غير محددين، و MCC هو 602، و MNC هو 04، ونوع المصادقة None أو PAP، ونوع APN هو default,supl، والبروتوكول IPv4/IPv6، وبروتوكول التجوال IPv4.

user_input: A postpaid customer wants to activate international roaming. What are the requirements?
response:
Thank you for reaching out! To activate international roaming, your postpaid account requires a minimum tenure of 3 months or a 1,000 EGP refundable deposit. However, if you are a VIP Indigo Gold or Platinum member, you can enjoy instant activation with no deposit required. Once eligible, you can easily activate your roaming passport bundle by dialing *202# or using the My WE App before or during your trip.

Agent steps:

- Check if the customer belongs to the VIP Indigo Gold or Platinum tiers for instant activation.
- If the customer does not meet the tenure or VIP criteria, inform them of the 1,000 EGP refundable deposit requirement.
- Advise the customer to activate roaming via *202# or the My WE App once eligibility is confirmed.
reference: Postpaid consumer accounts need a minimum active tenure of 3 months or a 1,000 EGP refundable deposit to activate international roaming. VIP Indigo Gold and Platinum customers get instant zero-deposit activation.

user_input: Is there a limit on data roaming charges if the customer has no Roaming Passport bundle?
response:
Yes, we have bill shock protection in place. If you do not have a Roaming Passport bundle, your data roaming usage is automatically hard-capped at 250 EGP per billing day. Once this limit is reached, your data will pause unless you explicitly opt-in via SMS to continue at standard pay-as-you-go rates. To avoid unexpected charges, we recommend checking our Roaming Passport bundles by dialing *202# or using the My WE App before you travel.

Agent steps:
- Inform the customer about the 250 EGP hard cap per billing day for data roaming without a bundle.
- Explain that data usage will pause automatically upon reaching this limit unless they opt-in via SMS to continue at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
- Recommend subscribing to a Roaming Passport bundle via *202# or the My WE App for more cost-effective options.
reference: Yes. Under NTRA consumer protection rules, data roaming without an active Roaming Passport bundle is hard-capped at 250 EGP per billing day, unless the customer explicitly opts in by SMS to continue at pay-as-you-go rates.

user_input: After a SIM replacement, why is the customer not receiving bank OTP messages?
response:
I understand how important it is to receive your banking OTPs, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Please try toggling Airplane Mode on your phone for 30 seconds, or perform a hard reboot. If you are still not receiving these messages after one hour, please let us know so we can perform a network re-synchronization to ensure your new SIM is fully active.

Agent steps:
- Verify the HLR/HSS status in the network diagnostics tool to ensure the SIM is correctly provisioned.
- Confirm that the IMSI mapping matches the ICCID printed on the new SIM card.
- Instruct the customer to toggle Airplane Mode for 30 seconds or perform a full hard reboot of the device.
- If the issue persists after 1 hour of provisioning, trigger an automated HLR re-synchronization via the CSR Portal.
reference: Under policy rule SEC-88, after any SIM replacement (physical or eSIM), all financial SMS notifications and banking OTPs are held in a mandatory 24-hour quarantine, while voice calls work immediately. The customer also receives a security SMS alert and has a 2-hour window to freeze the line by replying FREEZE if the replacement was unauthorized.
